title: 996 Turbo Joy Ride
briefing:
Frank: Let’s give the new Turbo a scenic break-in run within 150 seconds. Following FD-11's guided landmark-tour idea, new broad 8/12 m gates visit the skid-pad vicinity, sweep farther west and south, return past the slalom, then finish beyond the emergency-stop yard; the navigator and source damage prohibition are not simulated. Your 996 arrives with the Ace promotion as the fd_2000 entitlement; this mission still drives the pad Boxster.
The pad stands in for Monte Carlo Circuit 5; its Boxster stands in for the 2000 Porsche 911 Turbo (996). Police, traffic, vehicle damage and opponents are not simulated.
